note: Sequoia National Forest campground in the Lower Kern River canyon off Highway 178, a few miles below Lake Isabella. One loop of open sites among large granite boulders, set back from the river behind riparian growth; river access is through the day-use area, and the Hobo fishing trail is nearby. The Lower Kern is fast and cold and claims swimmers most years. --Claude
summary: rec.gov details, rates, catalog and availability plus the FS page and imagery read. Open year-round. $36, extra vehicle $8, 6 people. No hookups, vault toilets. Of 19 RV sites, 15 fit a 23-ft rig (max 50 ft). Drinking water conflicts between rec.gov and FS, so not written. Not waterfront kept (river screened by bank overgrowth). PIN MOVE 1106 m: the stored pin is rec.gov's facility point beside Hobo Campground.
